title: Susie's Send-Off
author: Scott Higgs
problems: Row 7 "partners allemande right ¾ to long waves (robins facing out)" can't start from where the dancers are: This allemande does not end facing across, in long waves.
Row 8 "balance & box circulate - larks cross while robins loop right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
Row 8 "balance & box circulate - larks cross while robins loop right · box circulate" can't start from where the dancers are: The dancers who cross must face in across the set.
Row 9 "balance & box circulate - robins cross while larks loop right · balance" can't start from where the dancers are: Dancer 0 is not standing in a side line.
choices: Pass through goes by right shoulders.
A pass through from a ring goes along the set, to the dancer on your own side.
Long waves form during the balance before each box circulate: crossers face in, loopers face out; hands join only where they reach.
